Codex pre-review (not a collaborator review; no marker) @ 0ecdcafa441ec958d43912ff5a8c399b8d5ee444

Verdict FINDINGS

- crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/structural.rs:17: Adding these pins grows this source file from 585 to 635 lines. AGENTS.md requires splitting files at about 400 lines. Move the stock pins into a focused test module.
- crates/ui/src/egui_app/stock_page.rs:52: The pins miss two protective guards. Removing the Setup-scope check still passes, so a mutant that clears unrelated Operation feedback is undetected. Removing the status-match check at line 55 also passes, so a mutant that clears a newer status is undetected. Add preservation cases for both.

Both named pins pass. The local merge with current upstream/main is clean. cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main passes. cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings passes.

Mutations: RED for removing fit-group hiding, action-shape hiding, feedback clearing, the shape-change check, status reset, and correct Delete routing. GREEN survivors for removing the Setup-scope check and the status-match check. All mutations restored. The final stock-filtered run passes 36 tests. The worktree is clean.

Extra safety case passes: enable Box per-side fitting, switch through From model to Cylinder, then fit. The resulting stock is Cylinder.

No added production unwrap/expect/panic. No changed goldens, snapshot PNGs, PROCESS_VERSION, Cargo dependencies, .github files or scripts. The body has Changelog: and Fixes #1683. Native interactive UI was not exercised.

Fixed the latest pre-review findings.

- Moved the stock pins from structural.rs to the focused tests/stock_fit.rs module. stock_fit_controls_follow_the_selected_shape and stock_shape_change_clears_the_fit_refusal still pass. Removing fit-group hiding makes the controls pin fail; restoring it passes.
- Added stock_shape_change_preserves_operation_feedback. Removing the Setup-scope guard makes it fail; restoring the guard passes.
- Added stock_shape_change_preserves_newer_status. Removing the status-match guard makes it fail; restoring the guard passes.

All four focused tests pass. cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main passes. cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings passes.

New head: 1445e64d347de48c1ff7bb3690b71dfc486443be.

Please re-review this head.

Codex pre-review (not a collaborator review; no marker) @ 1445e64d347de48c1ff7bb3690b71dfc486443be

Verdict CLEAN. No findings.

Local merge with upstream/main was already up to date. Reviewed the updated head after the stock pins moved to their own file.

Tests: all four stock_fit structural pins pass. The additional from_model_stock_refuses_fit_with_a_clear_status test passes. It checks that a direct caller bypassing the UI cannot create stock or an undo entry through the refused fit.

Gate: cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main passes.
Clippy: cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings passes.

Mutations: all eight are RED by assertion: fit-group visibility, fit-button visibility, Delete routing, feedback clearing, shape-change condition, Setup-scope condition, status-match condition, and status clearing. Restored source exactly; all four stock pins pass again. Worktree is clean.

Rule checks: no new production unwrap/expect/panic, golden changes, snapshot PNGs, PROCESS_VERSION, dependencies, workflow or script changes. Stock tests now live in a separate 101-line file; the existing test root only adds module wiring. Changelog and Fixes lines are present. Native interactive UI was not exercised.

Codex pre-review (not a collaborator review; no marker) @ 1445e64d347de48c1ff7bb3690b71dfc486443be

Verdict CLEAN. No findings.

Both named tests and all four new stock-fit pins pass. The existing direct-command From model refusal test also passes; callers outside the page still cannot fit source stock.

Quick gate against upstream/main: GREEN. The first attempt hit a sccache IPC error; retry with CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1 passed. UI clippy --all-targets with -D warnings: GREEN.

Mutations: fit-group visibility, fit-action visibility, shape-change feedback clearing, Setup scope, status equality, and Delete routing each made its pin RED with an assertion failure. All mutations were restored. Restored tests pass and the worktree is clean.

No new unwrap/expect/panic paths, goldens, PNGs, dependencies, process versions, workflows, or scripts changed. Changelog and Fixes #1683 are present. The page and new test file stay below 400 lines. The existing oversized tests.rs gains only a module declaration. Native interactive UI was not exercised.
